tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sbags te sgrub pa'i thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so//

༄༅// chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rig gter rang 'grel gyi mchod brjod las byung*/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs shing*// 'gro kun dge legs sgrub pa'i thugs rje can// bsam yas 'phrin las mdzad pa'i stobs mnga' ba// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba du ma'i mgon// gdul bya'i don du dpal ldan sa skya ru// chu pho dge byed dpyid zla ra ba yi// nyi shu drug la bltams pa nas bzung ste// sprul pa'i gnas su lcags phag smal po yi// bcu bzhi'i tho rangs zhi bar gshegs kyi bar// rab tu ngo mtshar rnam thar dpag med rnams// mdor bsdus 'chad la gus pas mnyan par gyis// byang chub sems kyi klu dbang spyi bo'i steng*// yon tan dpag med rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// shes rab zag med yum gyi rgya mtshor zhugs// dbang 'byor khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bltams pa'i dus na 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab// yum la ma gnod bde ba'i rnam pa rgyas// mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas mkha' la 'dus// mi mchog khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi ma mo ma bslabs khong du chud// gzhon nu'i dus nas yon tan thams cad rdzogs// mkhas pa du mas tshogs kyi dbus su bstod// blo ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mi nas mir gyur skye ba nyi shu lngar// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung gyur pas// bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /mtshungs bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa kun tu legs par sbyangs pas na// rmi lam na yang chos kyi sgo rnams kun// dge ba'i bshes kyis dngos su gdams pa mdzad// rnam dag khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// zab mo'i lam gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe// rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs// skad cig gcig la chos rnams thugs su chud// thugs grol khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// thabs kyi lam gyis 'byung bzhi rab tu sbyangs// ngag gi bzlas pas khro rgyal dngos su gzigs// bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa mchog tu gyur// skyon bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rtog ge ngan pa'i rgol ba thams cad bzlog

/rlom pas khengs pa'i rtog ge zil gyis gnon// mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab// 'jigs bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// yongs su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa kun tu spangs// chos kyi sbyin pa rtag tu lhug par gtong*// gzhan gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i// brtse ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya'i don du snyung ba'i tshul bstan tshe// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang byams mgon blo ldan dang*// zhi ba lha dang 'phags pa klu sgrub gyis// bsnyung gsol khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bsam pa dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis// 'jam pa'i dbyangs su mig gis mthong gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i yul na'ang gtam du de ltar grags// lhun grub khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// shing mo sbrul gyi dbyar zla 'bring po dang*// lcags pho khyi yi ston zla tha chung tshe// lcags mo phag la gzhan don 'gro zhes gsungs// dus mkhyen khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'dzin la gnas nas// bsnyung mi mnga' yang gdul bya thams cad kyi// sgrib pa sbyang phyir bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i// bsam yas khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// le lo can rnams brtson pa bskyed pa dang*// skal dman rnams la dge ba spel ba'i phyir// sku tshe'i 'du byed yang yang byin gyis brlabs// mnga' brnyes khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan don gshegs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa'i tshe// sems med sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos// bya rnams kun kyang ca co du ma sgrogs// byams chen khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe// bla ma rnams dang kye yi rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor lha rnams mngon sum gzigs par gyur// dbang ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// spyan ras gzigs kyis phyag gis dbu la byugs// rje btsun sgrol ma nam mkha'i mthongs su byon// 'jam dbyangs mgon po yang dang yang du gzigs// khyu mchog khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// sgra dbyangs mi zad sgrogs pa'i rgyal po dang*// shākya seng ge slob mar bcas pa sogs// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma yang yang gzigs// mi phul khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun mthu stobs nag po'i zhal snga nas// khyod ni nyi ma rgyal po'i bur gyur tshe// dri ma med dpal sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur zhes// lung bstan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gsang ba'i gnas ni lta bas mi mngon zhing*// dbu yi gtsug tor mchog tu gsal por 'phags// smin mtshams mdzod spu kha ba dung ltar 'khyil// mtshan ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rol mo'i sgra rnams mkha' las yang yang grags// 'ja' 'od rnam pa'i gdugs dang ba dan 'phyar// lha rnams shugs kyis sa yang rab tu g.yos// nyer zhi khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa'i stobs kyis skye bo dpag med 'dus// lha mi'i mchod pa phul du byung ba brnyes// sku gdung ring srel dad ldan rten tu bzhag

/phan dgongs khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ bar 'dir skye ba skye ba sogs 'jug pa'i srol 'dug kyang*/ gzhung tshig min pas dkyus su ma bris/ /yon tan tshad med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// mtshan dpes rab brgyan gsung dbyangs seng ge'i sgra// yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// 'gro mgon bla ma brgyud par bcas pa la// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod// lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa so sor bshags// bsod nams kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag tu bzhugs par gsol// mgon po khyod kyis byang chub tshul bstan tshe// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs nas kyang*// bdag sogs gdul bya yal bar mi 'dor zhing*// theg mchog bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad du gsol// gzungs dang spobs pa chos kyi gru sbyar te// nyon mongs las dang skye ba'i chu bo las// sems can thams cad legs par bsgral nas kyang*// mtha' gnyis las grol bde chen stsal du gsol// sems can bu tsha'i spyod pa ci 'dra yang*// pha ma'i byams pa'i 'dor bar mi 'gyur ltar// rmongs pas bslus pa bdag sogs gdul bya yi// spyod pa ci 'dra de 'drar thugs rjes gzigs// srid pa kun tu bla ma'i zhabs bsten cing*// rnyed dang bkur sti bsgrubs pas mchod byas te// ston pa'i 'du shes skad cig mi 'bral zhing*// skyon gyi rtog pas gos par ma gyur cig /bla ma'i mdzad pa ji ltar bstan na yang*// ngo mtshar mos pa rab tu 'phel 'gyur zhing*// bya ba kun la gzhan du'ang mi rtog par// phan pa'i 'du shes rtag tu rnyed gyur cig /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// sangs rgyas 'thob phyir rnam thar mdor bsdus nas// yan lag bdun pa legs par bsdebs pa 'di// lcags phag rgyal zlar ling chu rtse khab tu// rig pa smra ba yar klungs pa yis sbyar// bla ma chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa ste/

rgyas par rnam thar gyi yi ge chen mor blta bar bya'o/ ༈ /skye ba skye ba rnams su yang dang yang*// mkhas pa mkhas pa'i tshogs la sngon sbyangs pas// tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam na// gzhung lugs kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar sgom tshul bzhugs/ chos kun sprin ltar gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa can// 'gro kun bu ltar skyong ba'i brtse ba can// gzhan don bran ltar sgrub pa'i phrin las can// 'jam dbyangs paṇa chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// skal ldan gdul bya mchog la 'god phyir du// de yi rnal 'byor rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul// dad dang brtse ba'i bsam pas bri bar bya// dad brtson shes rab ldan rnams gus pas longs// chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i rnam thar bsgom par 'dod pas/ rigs drug la brtse ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong pa nyid bsgom pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa sngon du song bas/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du/ chos kyi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo/ sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad pas ut+pa la'i yu ba 'dzin pa snyan gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng*/ g.yas na shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba/ g.yon na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti yod pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa/ chos gos snam sbyar gsol ba/ de'i spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i steng du āḥdamar po/

thugs dkar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos rang rgyal/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ rang gi lus kyi gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar/ rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ sba lcag tsam gyi kha tshad bug tu bye ba'i nang du/ gdan gyi pad+ma'i yu ba zug pa/ spyi bo'i nang du zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ gang drin ma dang*/ sku'i spyod pa rnam dag ma dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa ci shes pa'i sgo nas bstod cing*/ gsol ba btab pas/ chos rje'i spyi bo'i oṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po babs chos rje'i sku brgyud/ rang gi spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas bdud rtsi dmar po babs/ rang gi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi sngon po babs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo gsum 'dres pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa lta bur babs/ rang gi rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ nyin par spyi bor bsgom/ mtshan mo rang gi lus gzhal yas khang*/ snying gar pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur khang nang du bzhugs pa la/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// zhes sogs kyis mchod bstod gsol ba btab la/ rang sems chos rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bstims la/ mi rtog pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya'o// tho rangs nas langs la/ sngar bzhin spyi bor bsgoms la/ gsol ba drag tu dus gsum rgyun du btab na/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par nges so// 'jam dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa byed na/ sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser/ de'i mtha' mar g.yas skor du oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes pa dmar ser gyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ sngags de brgya stong khri la sogs pa nyin re bzhin ci nus zla'o// mjug tu bstod gsol byas nas dngos grub blang ngo*// zhes pa 'di de nyid la dad pa brtan po thob pa g.yag gi ming can sangs rgyas dpal gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs bya tshul bzhugs so// dmar ser dhīḥyig 'od du 'khyil ba las// rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku// gdul bya'i yid mkhar bhū mi paṇ+ḍi ta// kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs kyis bdag skyongs shig /de la 'dir 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzhan la 'bogs par spro na/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du mchod pa bzang bar bsham/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'khod de/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod/ chos thams cad snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nyid ngo bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs la/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam pa can/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas snyan g.yas g.yon gyi ut+pala'i steng du ral gri dang pusti 'dzin par bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/

skyabs gnas thams cad bstim/ gang drin ma dang bstod pa chos rgyal ma tshar gcig gam gsum 'don/ dbang bzhi blang*/ bla ma rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs snying gar zla ba'i steng du bzhugs pa la/ thos pa rgya mtsho mas gsol ba btab la/ rang sems dang bla ma'i thugs gnyis ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang cung zad mnyam par bzhag skye ba kun tu yang dag sogs bya/ de nas slob ma bos la me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ 'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ chos 'di'i byung tshul ni/ mgon po byams pa'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen g.yag ston mi pham chos kyi bla ma de nyid kyi 'od gsal dag pa'i snang ba la/ sa paṇa nyid pod ral 'dzin pa'i sku'i rnam pa can du gsal bar gzigs/ de'i tshe thugs dad pa chen pos bstod pa mang du mdzad/ khyad par bstod pa chos rgyal mas bstod/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs rang la bstim pa sogs kyi nyams bzhes mdzad cing*/ de lta bu'i nyams len gyi rgyun de nyid kun mkhyen rong ston chen po la gnang*/ des zhal slob so so la gnang ba nas bzung deng sang gi bar du rgyun ma chad par byung zhing 'di la chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs su yang grags so// de lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid ngo bo bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/
zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

rje btsun grags pa'i rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa zhes rje grol mchog gsungs/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad pas ut+pala'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ de'i 'dab ma snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad dkar kha gyes pa'i steng gi g.yas na shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba/ g.yon na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti ka yod pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa/ chos gos dang snam sbyar gsol ba/ de'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs ka nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos rang rgyal/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma chos kyi rje la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar du rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba sba lcag tsam gyi kha tshangs bug tu bye ba'i nang du/ bla ma'i gdan pad+ma'i yu ba zug pa/ rang gi spyi bo yang oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bsams la/ gus 'dud dang bcas te bstod pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ gang drin ma tshar gsum dang*/ spro na/ sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa yang bya/ chos rgyal ma tshar gcig gam gsum la sogs pa 'don du bcug yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ chos kyi rje'i spyi bo'i oṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po babs/ sku'i nang brgyud rang gi spyi bo'i oṃ la thim pas lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang chos kyi rje'i mgrin pa'i ā las bdud rtsi dmar po babs/ rang gi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

yang chos kyi rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi sngon po babs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang chos kyi rje'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo gsum 'dres pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa lta bu babs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ chos kyi rje de nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs/ rang rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur khang du bzhugs pa la/ mos gus dung ba bsgoms la 'di gsung bar zhu/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma tshar gcig brjod du gzhug da khyed rang rnams kyi sems chos rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsams la/ gang du'ang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la cung zad re 'jog par zhu/ des bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs grub/ yang skabs gzhan du 'jam dbyangs sger bsnyen byed par 'dod na'ang rang gi spyi bor sngar bzhin chos rje bsgoms pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser de'i mthar g.yas skor du/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes pa dmar ser gyis bskor ba la dmigs te/ sngags brgya stong khri la sogs pa thun re la ci nus bzla/ thun gyi mjug tu/ bstod pa dang gsol btab byas nas/ dbang bzhi'i dngos grub blang*/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams kun du'ang*/ nyin mo bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ mtshan mo rang gi snying ga'i steng pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par bsams la/

mos gus 'du 'bral med par byas na/ bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing*/ byin rlabs thams cad 'jug nus pa yin/ de ltar gdams pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nyams len tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di gsung bar zhu/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du sogs/ mjug tu yig brgyas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'jam dbyangs dang chos rje'i sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya'o// zab las ches zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dis// bar chad kun sel mi brjed gzungs dang ni// rnam dpyod spobs pa yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin// bstan la bya ba byed pa'i mthu ldan 'gyur// zhes pa 'di yang dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ dgon gsar bde ba can du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// ༈ /'jam dpal dang sa paṇa sbags te sgrub pa'i nyams len bzhugs so// oṃ bde legs su gyur cig 'jam dpal dang sa paṇa sbags te sgrub par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ de nas rang gi lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gsal ba'i dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma khog stong mda' smyug tsam gyi yar sne spyi bor zug pa'i nang nas thon pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dhīḥyig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing*/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs su mdzad pa/ ut+pal zung gi 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar dgod pa'i ze ba la/ ye shes kyi ral gri dang*/ sher phyin gyi glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i yu ba dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ sku chos gos gsum gyis mdzes par bklubs pa/

mtshan dpe gsal bar rdzogs shing zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ shes bya thams cad sogs ci nus/ nyung na tshar gcig gi mthar/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab dbang phyug chos kyi rje// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun// dngul chu'i mdog can babs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud// spyi bor thim pas smin mtshams yan chad gang*// sku yis byin brlabs lus kyi dri ma dag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas bdud rtsi'i rgyun// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can dpag med babs// spyi bo'i lam brgyud mgrin pa yan chad gang*// gsung gis byin brlabs ngag gi dri ma dag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun// in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can dpag med babs// spyi bo nas brgyud snying ga yan chad gang*// thugs kyis byin brlabs sems kyi dri ma dag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun// sna tshogs dbang gzhu'i mdog can dpag med babs// spyi bo nas brgyud lus kun bdud rtsis gang*// byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bdag gis thob// snang grags chos kun sems kyi rol pa ste// sems snang sgyu ma sprul pa'i rta glang bzhin// bden pa med bzhin snang ba rten 'brel che// brjod bral 'dzin med chos sku'i rang zhal blta// zhes cung zad mnyam gzhag bya/ de nas/ bla ma dam pa 'od kyi gong bur bcas// rang la thim pas snying gar pad zla'i steng*// lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam pa can// 'od kyi drwa ba 'phro bzhin bzhugs pa yi// thugs kar mtshan mo'i mgon steng dhīḥyig mthar// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// bdag dang skye 'gro yongs kyi rmongs mun bcom// ye shes snang ba tshad med bskyed par gyur// oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ

zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ thos pa rgya mtsho nas/ mnyes gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod nas/ skyabs gnas dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing*// kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod// thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags// legs byas bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang*// sras bcas rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// de dag mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// dge tshogs 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo// zhes sam/ mi nus na/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// zhes sogs bya/ de nas/ brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtog pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol// rig pa'i gnas lngar sbyangs pa'i phul phyin nas// gzhan la 'chad pa'i spobs pa bdag la stsol// mkhas pa'i mdun sar rtsod pa'i grar zhugs nas// smra ngan pham byed spobs pa bdag la stsol// dpyod ldan mkhas pa kun gyis yid rton pa'i// sdeb legs rtsom pa'i spobs pa bdag la stsol// gnyis 'dzin mun pa 'thibs po mthar byed pa'i// spros bral 'od brgya'i snang ba bdag la stsol// de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing*// zhes sogs smon lam bya/ gnas skabs thams cad du sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta spyi gtsug gam snying gar gang bder bsgom zhing chos mthun gyi bya bas gnas par bya'o// ces pa 'di ni 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi gsung bzhin kun dga' tshul khrims gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/

bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad ut+pal glegs ral can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa rdor skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma dang sangs rgyas su mos pa'i drung du bdag dang mar gyur sems can thams cad 'khod nas 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'i bar gsum sogs ci nus brjod/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs brjod pas/ skyabs yul de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ skyabs su 'gro ba po rnams la phog pas/ sdig sgrib dag sangs rgyas su gyur nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs/ skyabs yul rang la thim pa'am mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum sogs kyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was chos thams cad snang stong sgyu ma lta bur sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid ngo bo 'jam dbyangs la rnam pa paṇ+ḍi ta sku mdog dmar ser zhag gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad nas ut+pa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i me tog snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i g.yas kyi steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/

g.yon gyi steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti yod pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ dbu la sa zhu dang*/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol ba/ de'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drang*/ spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i chos rje la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi lus kyi gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ sbom phra sba lcag tsam gyi kha tshangs bug tu phye ba'i nang du chos kyi rje'i gdan pad+ma'i yu ba zug pa/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal bar gyur par bsams la ngag tu brjod cing gsal btab/ de nas bdag la skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dma' ci byung yang chos rje nyid las re sa gzhan na med pas thugs rjes gzigs shig snyam pa'i mos gus drag po snying gi dkyil nas dung lhang lhang pa dang bcas/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs shing*// sogs sh+lo ka gcig brgya stong nas bdun gyi bar brjod/ shes na chos rgyal ma rgyas bsdus gang rigs tshar gsum mam gcig brjod la bzlas pa bya ba ni/ chos rje'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser gyi mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du oṃ a ra pa tsa na zhes pa kha dog dmar ser gyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drang*/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de las 'od zer dmar ser gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur/ ces dang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa de yang yang gsal 'debs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes thun re la brgya stong khri sogs ci 'grub dang*/ bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag brgyad cu tsam bzla'o// gang ltar yang thun gyi rjes su/ 'jam mgon bla ma nyid la mos gus dung pa dang bcas phyogs bcu dus gsum ma tshig lhug gi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ yang na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen rab kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ chos rje'i dpral ba'i oṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po babs/ sku'i nang brgyud gdan pad+ma'i yu ba la 'khril nas rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas bdud rtsi dmar po babs/ rang gi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi sngon po babs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dngos grub thob/

chos rje'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo gsum 'dres pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa lta bu babs/ rang gi sgo gsum la thim/ lus kyi nang gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ chos rje de rang gi spyi bo'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs/ de ma thag tshangs bug gi sgo 'grigs/ lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du snying pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du 'ja' 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur gyi nang na dus rtag tu 'bral ba med par bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang*/ nang gi mchod pa phul bar bsams la/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// zhes sogs nas/ 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /gi bar dang*/ sa skya paṇa chen rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod pa yang dag pa'i don la blo gzhag pa ni lus gnad dang ldan pas/ chos rje'i thugs dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can de la shes pa gtad nas/ chos rje'i thugs dang*/ rang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pa bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la rtog pa'i bsre lhad ci'ang mi bya bar ci tsam gnas gyi bar du mnyam par bzhag thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing*// sogs sh+lo ka gnyis dang*/ sems can nad pa ji snyed pa sogs dang*/ phyogs rnams kun na lus dang sems// sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gang dag ji snyed sogs dang*/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs dang*/ gangs can bod kyi sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// zhes 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la brten pa'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul 'di'ang*/

sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab nas byung ba bzhin la/ rang gi rgyun du nyams su len tshul ji lta ba bzhin bcos bslad med par sbyar ba 'di yi gsol 'debs dang*/ smon lam rnams 'di dang 'brel chags gang yin rang gi blos bcad nas bya ba yin la nges sbyar mi dgos shing*/ yig rnying rnams las nyin mo spyi bo dang mtshan mo snying gar bsgoms nas bzlas pa byed mi byed 'dam ka mdzad kyang gong gi des ma 'thus pa ci'ang med pas 'di bzhin nyams su blangs na gnas skabs su las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du 'grub cing mthar thug chos rje nyid kyi go 'phang thob par gdon mi za'o// zhes pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// ༈ /'jam dbyangs bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho kha bhū mi paṇ+ḍa ra ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta s+ya pat+pa d+mā bh+yāṃ/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs pad+mor// rab tu gus pas phyag btsal nas// gang de mchod pa'i cho ga ni// tshogs gnyis char 'bebs bshad kyis nyon// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag cing*/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i rnam thar la mi 'phrog pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas khang byi dor byas pa'i phugs su stegs mtho bar rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku'i snang brnyan bris 'bur gang rigs kyis gtsos sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhugs su gsol ba'i spyan sngar/ mchod stegs bang rim can lta bur ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa spyi dang*/ bye brag tu spos/

mar re/ zhal zas rnams brgya rtsa sogs gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ bla re dang gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pas brgyan/ rang gi mdun du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal mtho gang las mi chung ba/ dri bzang gi chu/ tshom bu'i rgyu 'bru gtsang ma/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyis rgyud sbyang ba/ tshogs kyi zhing gsal gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar brjod cing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ gnyis pa ni/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci mang dang*/

thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyi bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes skyabs gsol byas nas skyabs yul rang la bstim/ smon 'jug gi don dran bzhin pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid ngo bo 'jam dbyangs la rnam pa paṇ+ḍi ta sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad nas ut+pa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i me tog snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i g.yas kyi steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon gyi steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti yod pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ dbu la sa zhu dang*/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol ba/ de'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i chos rje la/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas/ rang gi lus kyi gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ sbom phra sba lcag tsam gyi kha tshangs bug tu phye ba'i nang du chos kyi rje'i gdan pad+ma'i yu ba zug pa/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal bar gyur par bsams la ngag tu brjod cing gsal gdab bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bsag sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa bya ba'o// dang po la'ang bdun las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag sogs mchod pa'i las la 'jug par mos pa dang bcas/ mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yab/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla ma/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi skyabs/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// brtse ba chen pos dus thams cad du rjes su gzung du gsol/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rang byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*// me shel med par me mi 'byung*// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur// des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel/

byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston// nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mkhyen// thams cad spro ba'i phrin las kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul// gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba ni// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad// gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa// de la de ma thag byin rlobs// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs 'tshang rgya// yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub// des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog /dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel pa kun// srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob bar// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid sgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// khyod mnyes bgyis pa'ang thob par shog/ //sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog

/skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub par byed par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dngos grub kun gyi rin chen gter// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig bsdus pa// 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i// zhabs kyi pad+mor gus pas 'dud// khyed kyis bsod nams ye shes tshogs// bskal pa du mar rab bsgrubs pas// bzhed pa'i don rnams yongs rdzogs pa'i// dpal ldan don grub

dpal ldan don grub ces pa 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sku chung ngu'i dus kyi mtshan no// la phyag 'tshal// 'khrul pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// tshul khrims phung pos brgyan pa'i sku// mthong ba tsam gyis rab dad par// mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ca co mi mnga' rnam dag gsung*// tha dad skad kyis mtha' yas pa'i// gdul bya'i dbang po tshim mdzad pa'i// gsung mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam par gzhag cing rtog mi mnga'// 'gro ba'i yid la mnyam par 'jug /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi gter/ rnam grol thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'di// ma lus thugs su chub gyur pas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas// gzhan don dus las mi 'da' ba'i// brtse chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse brtson pa'i stobs chen gyis// bdud kyi stobs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// nyon mongs byang chub lam sgyur pa'i// mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar// rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis// de srid de yi don mdzad pa'i// phrin las dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// kun dga'i dgos 'dod ma lus pa// rin chen rgyal mtshan las byung ba'i// dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'bras stsol ba'i// dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa gzhan don phyir// so so skye bo'i skur ston pa// mtshungs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum po khyod nyid de// khyod nyid dkon mchog gsum yang lags// de bas rnam pa thams cad du// khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ston mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dren pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la khyod kyi skus reg cing*// khyod gsung thos shing 'dzin pa dang*// khyod kyi thugs rjes rjes bzung ba// de dag kun la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing*// rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas// bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa mchod pa la/

spyir mchod pa ni/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// rab dang yid las byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen po brnyes gyur cig /bye brag nyer spyod/ rin chen bdun/ 'dod yon lnga rnams 'bul ba ni/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla mar mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ sil snyan dang*/ shab+da rnams sbyar ba'i mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi ta brjod cing rol mo bya/ oṃ sarba bitra pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ zhes brjod cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog

/ma ṇi rat+na= btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa sti rat+na= blon po rin chen= /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /mahā ta rat+na= glang po rin chen= /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na= rta mchog rin chen= /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /a shwa rat+na= dmag dpon rin chen= /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍ+ga rat+na= kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos sogs= shab+da= phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// gan+dhe= /phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// rā sa= /phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// spar+ṣe= /zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ legs par bshams pa'i maṇ+ḍal phyag len ltar dbul zhing*/ spro na tshom bu so bdun ma/ mjug tu gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang bcas pa bya/ gang ltar yang*/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'dir// dbus kyi ri rgyal ri rab la// gling bzhi 'dod yon lnga yis brgyan// nyi ma zla bas skor ba byed// lha mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs// rgyal srid rin chen rnam pa bdun// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing*// ma rmos lo tog gser dang dngul// 'bru bzang longs spyod bsam mi khyab// dngos po bzang la gya nom pa// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus dbul/ gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag ma lnga ni/ bdag ni thog med dus nas su// las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas// rang bzhin sdig pa ci bgyis dang*// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa'i// nyes pa'i tshogs kun rab 'gyod pas// mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan snga ru// slad chad bsdam pa'i sems kyis bshags// bla ma'i phrin las rmad byung dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom so so skye bo yi// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// 'gro kun smin cing grol bya'i phyir// bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas la// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas// 'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad par// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas dang*// chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// rtag tu gus pas bdag skyabs mchi// sems can kun gyi don slad du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par bgyi// ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan pa'i// brtse ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun// yud tsam bdag la dgongs su gsol// ma rig pa yis ldongs gyur cing*// las kyi chu klung gis 'phangs pas// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung gyur te// nyon mongs chu srin dbang gyur pas// mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i// nyam chung blo gros rab dman pa// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// skyob pa mdzad par gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag rnams kyis rab 'bad kyang*// thar pa'i go skabs rnyed par dka'// khyed kyis thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs nas// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// mngon par 'du byed kun gyi gzhi// tshul min yid la byed pa'i rgyu// ma rig mun pa thibs po che// ye shes zer gyis bsal du gsol// srid pa'i nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// rtog pa thams cad skyed byed pa// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khri shing ni// shes rab ral gris gcad du gsol// kun rmongs kun 'khrugs kun nas dkris// nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog kun// mgon po khyod kyi mthu chen gyis// ye shes chen por bsgyur du gsol// srid pa thogs med dus nas su// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// bag chags dri ma gang bsags pa// ye shes chu yis sbyang du gsol// rang gis mngon par spyad pa'i mthus// rang la rang dbang med par ni// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'phen byed pa'i// las kyi rlung shugs bzlog tu gsol// las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i// skye rga na dang 'chi ba sogs// sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba yi// sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad du gsol// thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba las// sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i// bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol// 'jig rten pa yi don gnyer ba'i// rnyed dang bkur sti la sogs pa// snying po med pa'i bya ba las// yid ni rab tu bzlog tu gsol// kun gzhi'i lte ba rab brtan cing*// rten 'brel yan lag rtsibs bcu gnyis// sdug bsngal mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i// srid pa'i 'khor lo gzhig tu gsol// gzhan don la skyo bdag chags pas// rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer ba// nyan thos theg pa dman pa'i sems// rnam pa kun tu dgag tu gsol// bdag gi lus dang ngag dang ni// de bzhin yid kyi sgo nas kyang*// sems can kun la rnam kun tu// phan pa rgya chen 'byung bar shog

/rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la// phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa thams cad kun// nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bshes gnyen grogs mchog dam chos dang*// gnas bzang ba dang yo byad sogs// rtag tu mthun pa'i rkyen rnams kun// lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*// 'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsams pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe// bla ma mchog dang he ru kaḥ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su bkri bar mdzod// mang du smros kyang ci 'tshal te// dbang bcu ldan pa khyed rnams kyis// ji ltar go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// de ltar bdag gis thob par mdzod// bdag gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// rnam pa kun tu nyam thag pas// mi shes bzhin du gsol ba la// nyes pa snang gang bzod par gsol// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag gi tshe rabs thams cad du// rigs gzugs 'byor ldan shes rab dang*// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs gyur cing*// nad med tshe dang ldan gyur cig /sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnam pa kun tu mchod par shog /kun dga'i gsung rab rtag nyan cing*// sku yi rgyal mtshan blta ba dang*// de yi dpal 'byor bzang po yis// rtag tu bdag ni spyod par shog /dad dang brtse dang brtson pa'i mthus// byang chub lam rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// sems can smin par byed par shog /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar// bdag las sems can thams cad kyi// yid la 'dod dgu 'byung 'gyur zhing*// 'gro kun tshim par byed par shog

/bdag la brten nas 'gro ba kun// zab mo'i lam la rab zhugs nas// srid dang zhi la mi gnas pa'i// byang chub chen po thob gyur cig /blo gros sgrib gnyis rnam dag pas// shin tu zab pa'i blo gros dang*// rgya che'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i// blo gros chen por bdag gyur cig /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs bzung bas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan byas nas// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan slong bar shog /tshogs gnyis dpal rab rdzogs gyur nas// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'byung ba'i gzhi// sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun grub ste// srid zhi'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /smon lam bzang po las byung ba'i// phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba kun// skal ba bzang po'i legs sgrub pa'i// brtul zhugs bzang por bdag gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// rjes su bdag kyang rab zhugs nas// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// thams cad yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces don yid la dran bzhin du 'dun pa rtse gcig pas brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ bdag la skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman ci byung yang chos rje nyid las re sa gzhan med pas thugs rjes gzigs shig snyam pa'i mos gus snying gi dkyil nas dung dung lhang lhang ba dang bcas/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i sogs dang*/ chos gyi rgyal po sogs rnam thar gsol 'debs tshar ci nus rjes/ shes bya ma sh+lo ka gcig pu brgya stong sogs grangs bsag de'i tshe rnam par thar pa'i don rjes su dran pas mos gus shugs drag tu bsgom par bya ste/

tshul 'di la chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar bsgom tshul zhes kyang gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ chos rje'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser gyi mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du oṃ a ra pa tsa na zhes pa kha dog dmar ser gyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de las 'od zer dmar ser gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur/ ces dang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa de yang yang gsal 'debs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes ci nus bzla/ gsum pa rjes la gsum/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa/ dbang dang dngos grub blangs shing de kho na nyid la mnyam par gzhag pa/ bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ thal mo sbyar te 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje/ chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos dam pa'i 'byor pa thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs shing*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dam par gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi rkyen las gyur pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa srid par 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don la skyo ba dang*/ rang nyid zhi bar 'dun pa la sogs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa gang lags pa thams cad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi sems las su rung ba dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin yang dag pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnam par dag cing sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ ltung ba dang nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis zung du chud nas/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi snang ba dam pa dang rtog pa dge ba khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi tshe bdag 'chi bar gyur pa de'i tshe tshe 'di dang 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen pa dang bral zhing lus dang sems la zug rngu dang sdug bsngal cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung bar dga' ba dang spro ba dang yid gsal ba mchog dang ldan zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yang dag par mthong zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bsus te/ bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/

bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul thams cad las shin tu 'das nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing srid pa dang zhi ba'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs yang dag par bzung nas/ chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ slar yang mos gus gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen rab kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ chos rje'i dpral ba'i oṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po babs/ sku'i nang brgyud gdan pad+ma'i yu ba la 'khril nas rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas bdud rtsi dmar po babs/ rang gi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi sngon po babs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo gsum 'dres pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa lta bu babs/ rang gi sgo gsum la thim/ lus kyi nang gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ chos rje de rang gi spyi bo'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs/ de ma thag tshangs bug gi sgo 'grigs/ lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du snying pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du 'ja' 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur gyi nang na dus rtag tu 'bral ba med par bzhugs par gyur ces dang*/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dwang ba spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying gi chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /sa skya paṇa chen rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod pas khyad par gyi mchod pa dbul/ de nas yang dag pa'i don la blo gzhag pa ni lus gnad dang ldan pas/ chos rje'i thugs dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can de la shes pa gtad nas chos rje'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pa bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la rtog pa'i bsre lhad ci yang mi bya bar ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag

gsum pa ni/ thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la bgrod par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing*// sa skya paṇa chen byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas// mngon dga'i zhing du bdag cag dpon slob rnams// tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /de nas bde ba can sogs sa skya pa'i// rje btsun gong ma bzhugs pa dag pa'i zhing*// mang du bgrod nas spang rtogs myur rdzogs te// sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// myur du nad las thar gyur cig /'gro ba'i nad ni ma lus pa// rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /phyogs rnams kun na lus dang sems// sdug bsngal nad pa ji snyed pa// de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis// bde dga' rgya mtsho thob par shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa// de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur// 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni// mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i skyob pa mchog gyur pa// mkhas grub rgya mtshos yongs su gang ba'i gnas// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan pa gsal mdzad pa// sa skya pa yi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /gangs can bod kyi lte ba rdo rje gdan// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid rgyas gyur cing*// sprul pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun chad med pa dang*// kun kyang phrin las nam mkha' mnyam par shog /'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par byas te spyod lam la 'jug go /'jam dbyangs bla ma mchod pa'i tshul// tshogs gnyis char 'bebs rdzogs ldan sprin// 'di sbyar dge bas 'gro ba kun// phan bde'i 'byor pa rgyas gyur cig

/ces 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam 'bras phyag mchod sogs bla ma gong ma'i gsung byin rlabs can phyag len ltar khrigs su bsdebs pa 'di'ang*/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa su shre yo lak+ṣ+mīṃ bha ba tu/// / ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
